name: Dishonest People
overview: Scripture clearly condemns dishonesty, commanding believers not to bear false witness against their neighbors, as stated in Exodus 20:16. The deceitful ways may seem appealing at first, but Proverbs 20:17 warns that such sweetness turns bitter, leading to ruin. God hates deceit and considers it an abomination (Proverbs 6:16), emphasizing the importance of truthfulness aligned with His righteous and enduring word (Psalms 119:160). When offenses occur, Matthew 18:15 instructs believers to lovingly confront and restore, reflecting the heart of Christ's redemptive love shown in John 3:16.
